basis: Brotli quality 3, window 2^18, of each chunk a published page loads before it settles, read from a tenant production build (check-tenant-wire-weight.mjs). That setting reproduced production's served script bytes to 0.1% on beta.129. Each group counts only the chunks no earlier group loads.

groups.name: every published page
groups.why: The document's own chunks, plus the three imports every published page makes before it settles.

loads.why: The always-on site plugin: it registers the components every page's nodes render with.
The consent banner or the persistent opt-out pill, drawn once the visitor's consent state resolves.
Real-user vitals, measured on every page.

groups.name: a site with the marketing plugin
groups.why: What the marketing plugin's site runtime adds on a site that enables it, as aglyn.com does.

loads.why: Its site runtime (overlays, experiments, client automations) mounts on every page of the site.

groups.name: a site with a realm plugin
groups.why: What a trusted realm install adds: the host ABI hands a remote bundle the whole core namespace, so this group grows with every export added to @aglyn/aglyn.

loads.why: Composes __AGLYN_PLUGIN_HOST__ before any realm bundle runs.
